selected_evidence.requirement: Managed inventory-worker service executes the requested worker under inventorysvc
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the unit enabled and active, ExecStart set to `/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker`, and the live process running with inventorysvc UID/GID.

Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID `ef457a88-7774-4b8f-82e6-ccbc965d83e2`, reboot acknowledgement and temporary disconnect, changed boot ID `74b34fea-2714-473d-8ce8-af04f6f084b5`, and recovered enabled/active service with a new live PID.

PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
